properties.name: DEFECT: the wall check is recorded as working "on any project, with no configuration" and "a reflow2 user gets this the moment they have registered artifacts" — but it is a script under tools/ in this repo, the consumer kit does not ship it, and find_tools cannot return it; a consumer re-wrote it by hand 25 days after it was built
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-14. .github/workflows/release.yml packages the consumer kit as `tools/reflow2_init.py`, `tools/reflow2_install.py` (line 106 — a correction to the first version of this record, which said the kit carried only reflow2_init.py and getting-started/; the consumer-reach gate written the same afternoon caught the omission by flagging the installer as unreachable, so the gate now reads the shipped set off release.yml itself) and `getting-started/`. tools/wall_check.py is not among them. reflow2_init.py installs skills and the MCP config and, by design, "never a src/ layout or build file". find_tools searches the SERVED surface (181 entries); asked the user-phrased question the capability answers — "does my declared decomposition match the real coupling" — it returns evaluate_allocation, detect_defects, realizes and seam_coverage, none of which reads source.

THE CLAIM ON THE RECORD: this capability's description says "a reflow2 user gets this the moment they have registered artifacts, which link-artifacts already asks them to do" and was "GENERALISED 2026-08-21 (PROPOSAL 3, Anthony's word) from a reflow2-only script into something that works on whatever project a design describes." The generalisation was of the CODE — it reads any design's Artifact locations — not of the DELIVERY. A reflow2 user who installed from the kit has no such file and no served tool that names it.

THE CONSEQUENCE, observed: an agent on a work project (fact:a-work-project-hand-rolled-four-analyses…) wrote the import-boundary walk by hand on 2026-09-14 and diagnosed it "unknown". That is the identical hand-rolled script that this capability was BUILT FROM on 2026-08-20 — the same question, answered by hand a second time, on a second project, after the answer existed. The three-leg rule, one more time: the code exists; no instruction and no served entry points a consumer at it; nothing notices a consumer doing it by hand except the consumer.

THE ROOT CAUSE was walked the same day (fact:root-cause-the-wall-check-was-generalised-in-code-and-never-in-reach-and-the-checkout-cannot-feel-it): the kit is a symptom; the cause is the three consumer legs — served, named, gated — all absent, on a checkout that cannot feel their absence. FIXED by serving the script from the binary as the `wall_check` tool, naming it in check-health and adopt, and the consumer-reach gate.
